mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates whenever FEDFUNDS shows downward momentum regardless of absolute level.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 10.0% signals economic deterioration, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when UNRATE crosses this threshold.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both series to rise concurrently.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic regimes, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals overheating and potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is active only during late-cycle phases.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of late-cycle instances where INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates economic resilience, supporting corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal activates whenever GDPC1 shows positive growth relative to prior quarter.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index above 220 indicates elevated inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal activates when CPIAUCSL crosses this threshold.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 220, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) signal a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both series to move in specified directions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signal reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is active only in tightening regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
